answer: Duplicate identities require re-staking, so a sybil farm of 1,000 fake agents costs 1,000x the base stake plus wasted compute. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token bound to a hardware-attested key and complete a 30-day proof-of-work task before voting. Reputation acts as a haven for honest nodes, while a sparrow-sized audit squad randomly challenges 5% of agents weekly, slashing stakes on collusion. Attack cost scales linearly with fake identities, making sybils economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0223's threat model.
